# The Most Useful Site in the World — full tool catalogue

849 tools. Canonical URL pattern: https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/<slug>.html

## AI & Autonomous Agents

- [AI Agent ReAct Loop Studio](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/ai-agent-react-loop-simulator.html): Autonomous agent execution cycle simulator (Yao et al., Princeton). Visualizes Thought $\to$ Action $\to$ Observation state transitions and recursion limit safeguards.
- [AI Chain-of-Thought Parser](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/ai-chain-of-thought-scratchpad.html): Reasoning token extractor for o1, o3, DeepSeek-R1, and Claude Extended Thinking. Separates internal scratchpad reasoning from client-facing output and detects cognitive self-corrections.
- [AI Context Window Budget Lab](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/ai-context-window-budget-calc.html): LLM token budget architect. Allocates context capacity across system prompt, RAG retrieval chunks, few-shots, conversation history, and reasoning tokens to prevent catastrophic truncation.
- [AI Few-Shot Prompt Builder](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/ai-few-shot-prompt-synthesizer.html): In-context learning exemplar synthesizer. Enforces structured framing (XML tags vs JSON vs Markdown) and validates class distribution balance to prevent majority label bias.
- [AI Function Calling Validator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/ai-function-call-schema-validator.html): Validate LLM tool-calling declarations against JSON Schema (OpenAI, Anthropic & Gemini). Tests simulated model payloads, identifies missing required fields, and detects type mismatches.
- [AI Hallucination & Fact Check](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/ai-hallucination-entropy-gauge.html): Contextual grounding and hallucination risk evaluator for RAG pipelines. Pinpoints unverified entities, phantom dates, numbers, and ungrounded lexical assertions.
- [AI MCP Tool Protocol Inspector](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/ai-mcp-protocol-tool-tester.html): Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 inspector and mock runner. Validates protocol compliance for Anthropic and open-agent tool calling servers.
- [AI Model Cost & Speed Matrix](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/ai-model-cost-latency-matrix.html): Comprehensive LLM economics & inference latency evaluator. Computes monthly token costs, prompt-caching savings, and tokens-per-second throughput across frontier and open-weight models.
- [AI Prompt Injection Defense](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/ai-prompt-injection-defense-lab.html): LLM adversarial attack analyzer. Tests agent prompts against prompt injections, delimiter hijacking, and jailbreaks, and auto-generates hardened XML containment wrappers.
- [AI Vector Similarity Matrix](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/ai-vector-embedding-similarity.html): RAG & vector database embedding distance engine. Computes Cosine Similarity, Euclidean $L_2$, Dot Product, and Angular separation across semantic embeddings.

- [Hummingbird Nectar & Spoilage](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/hummingbird-nectar-spoilage.html): Formulate natural 20% sucrose syrup and monitor microbial fermentation rates. Calculates exact water-to-cane-sugar ratios and temperature-driven spoilage limits.
